name: AI Decorator
description: Decorate a selected structure in styles learned from 139 real levels, and add trigger effects. Works offline.

max-objects.name: Max Objects
max-objects.description: Upper limit on how many decoration objects are placed in one go.

layers-per-side.name: Layers Per Side
layers-per-side.description: How many decorations can stack on one side of a block (real levels often stack 2-3 glow/detail pieces).

scenery-amount.name: Background Scenery
scenery-amount.description: How much background decoration to add around the structure. 0 turns it off.

color-channel-start.name: Style Color Channels
color-channel-start.description: Styles use up to 6 color channels starting at this one. Pick a range your level doesn't use.

auto-pulse.name: Beat Pulses
auto-pulse.description: When applying, add Pulse triggers on the glow color across the structure, spaced and timed like the source level (most levels: every ~4 blocks, instant flash, 0.3s fade).

glow-opacity.name: Glow Opacity
glow-opacity.description: Opacity of the style's glow (blending) color channels. The analyzed levels almost all use 1.0.
